policy.promotionGate: requires separate causal validation before any coefficient or tier change
policy.fplTransferHandling: FPL unavailable players whose news indicates transfer/loan are classified departed/not_at_club, not injured
policy.availabilitySemantics: source-known, lineup-history-ready, and weighted-availability-ready are separate states
policy.archiveSource: withqwerty/availability-data previous season; Transfermarkt-derived; research only
policy.extendedContext: workload/rest/short-turnaround + rotation proxy + expected-XI role shape + manager tracking + confirmed-XI richness; shadow only
policy.tacticalSemantics: role-shape is descriptive player-position composition; it is not formation/tactical intent
